handoff.summary: Prepared a fail-atomic ordinary-Python C4 coordinator that authenticates the eventual 153088-bit C3 owner, preserves source ordering, derives the regulator multiple and candidate L/R, and explicitly leaves analytic acceptance pending. The protocol distinguishes 153152-bit internal embedding guard precision, genuine compute_R myprecdbl retry, and terminal getfu PRECI. Lifted the connected packed-real validation corridor, added a fresh PARI 2.17.4 reconstruction differential, high-precision fallback probes, and authority mutation tests. No real field-3 mathematical owner is published and no heavy native build was run.
risks: The real complete C3 A owner does not yet exist, so only synthetic target-precision execution is exercised.
The permitted inputs do not contain PARI's field-derived h*invhr factor or terminal HNF; authentic denominator-bound derivation and bad_check(z*R) acceptance remain downstream.

The full pnpm test:baselib:strict wrapper is blocked by a pre-existing doubled-backtick docstring in field3_high_precision_hnf_transform.py outside this lane; the underlying strict CPython/Ruff/Pyright checker passes with zero errors.
next_steps: Bind the real complete C3 owner hash/generation/order to this coordinator and replay its 153088-bit scalars, retaining 153152 only as the embedding/root guard precision.

Add authenticated terminal-HNF and field-derived h*invhr derivations, derive the denominator bound, and replay PARI bad_check before promoting candidate L/R to accepted owners; use 229632 only after a live compute_R PRECI.
Only then hand the accepted L/R owners to cleanarch/getfu.
